mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair guanfacine clearance and increase hypotensive effects while elevating risk of cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and blood pressure closely; consider dose adjustment or alternative antifungal if possible; correct electrolyte abnormalities promptly.
